reuse.why: Introduces a shared category selection for most month-wide actions, but stores group notes in a new category_groups.notes column instead of the existing notes table that already holds category, group and month notes, and does not reuse the selection for copyPreviousMonth.

duplication.why: Collapses the three copied category queries into getMonthActionCategories, but the new action re-copies the per-action income/tracking check and loop shape, and copyPreviousMonth keeps its own hidden filter.

placement.why: Selection logic sits sensibly in budget/actions.ts, but the schema migration adding a notes column to category_groups puts group notes in a different place from where the tree stores every other note.

scope.why: Changes relate to the requested steps; the migration and DbCategoryGroup type change are consequences of the questionable notes design rather than unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Group notes now exist in two stores (notes table edited by the UI vs the new column read by the filter), so the #fixed tag users write will not be seen, and copyPreviousMonth silently follows different exclusion rules.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getMonthActionCategories reads g.notes from a new category_groups column instead of the notes table (notes n WHERE n.id = group id); copyPreviousMonth bypasses getMonthActionCategories with its own hidden/group_hidden filter.

disguised_duplication.where: The income/tracking check in setLastMonthSpending and copyPreviousMonth's hidden filter are plain repetitions, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories gains includeHiddenCategories with an inline SQL ternary; copyPreviousMonth (a month-wide action) still selects categories through getBudgetData plus its own hidden check, ignoring template and #fixed exclusions.
